craft_notes: Sthāyin: swell-and-hide (all held, all dropped). Rows: row 2 (hide→world?). Close: indeed (vai as landing: the neither-neither sealed). Rejected: 'creation/destruction' — kept swell/hide (jāti/tirodhāna as play, not cosmology); 'everyone' for all — kept world (jagat).

lines: When your own shape swells — you, I, and the whole world.
When its hiding is born — no you, no I, no world indeed.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tvatsvarūpe jṛmbhamāṇe tvaṃ cāhaṃ cākhilaṃ jagat | jāte tasya tirodhāne na tvaṃ nāhaṃ na vai jagat

reads_against.argmap: What when you expand, what when you withdraw? → Expansion holds all three; withdrawal holds none: being and nonbeing of you, me, world turn on your play.
c1_essence: Expansion holds you-me-world; withdrawal holds none.
